name: Web app
description: Frontend, backend and tests leads for a web project, with a dev server for live previews.
instructions: This is a web application. Keep changes small and reviewable, one concern per thread. Run the type checker and the tests before you call something done. Never commit secrets; read them from the environment.

leads.name: Frontend
leads.instructions: Owns the user interface: components, styling, accessibility and client-side state. Match the existing design system and check both light and dark themes.

leads.name: Backend
leads.instructions: Owns the server: API routes, data models, migrations and integrations. Validate input at the edges and keep endpoints backwards compatible.

leads.name: Tests
leads.instructions: Owns the test suite and CI. Add tests for every bug fixed, keep the suite fast, and flag flaky tests instead of retrying them.

issues.title: Write down how to run the project locally
issues.body: Install steps, environment variables, and the dev command, in the README.

issues.title: Set up linting and formatting
issues.body: One formatter and one linter, wired into a script and CI.

issues.title: Audit the main screens for accessibility
issues.body: Keyboard navigation, focus states, labels and contrast.

issues.title: Run the tests on every pull request
